title: Cho tôi xin chén súp riêng được không?
englishTitle: Can I have soup on the side?
pronunciation: Cho toi xin chen sup rieng duoc khong
summary: For asking to keep broth or soup separate so the dish stays the way you want it at the table or takeaway counter.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Cho tôi xin chén súp riêng được không? keeps the food or drink request clear before details spread out.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Point to the bowl or menu photo, then ask for the soup on the side.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin chén súp riêng được không?
phrases.english: Can I have soup on the side?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi xin chen sup rieng duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Riêng is the part that makes the request separate: it asks for the soup apart from the main bowl.

breakdown.english: may I have / please give me

breakdown.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin chén súp riêng được không?
breakdown.english: Can I have soup on the side?

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it at a noodle shop or restaurant when broth, soup, or sauce would be easier in a separate bowl.

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi cơm ăn kèm được không?
phrases.english: Can I have rice with this?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi com an kem duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Xin vui lòng cho nước sốt vào bên cạnh
phrases.pronunciation: Xin vui long cho nuoc sot vao ben canh

phrases.vietnamese: Cho tôi xin chanh được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Cho toi xin chanh duoc khong

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Riêng means separate. It is the important word if the staff is checking what should stay apart.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: Keep can I have napkins?; can I order half a portion?; two of these, please ready for the next turn.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể dùng tương ớt được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the dung tuong ot duoc khong

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể có khăn ăn được không?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the co khan an duoc khong

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: If the answer changes what you need, try more herbs please; a spoon and chopsticks please; can I have rice with this?
